text:
Maya Chen: Hey team — hitting a weird edgecase in the starter-kit sample app. When using the fn-call helper in JSON mode, nested nullable arrays become [] instead of nulls. This breaks our schema checks in prod tests.

Maya Chen: Repro (minimal):
```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "json_mode": true,
  "function_call": { "name": "order.update", "arguments": { "items": null } }
}
```
Response from SDK helper converts items -> [] instead of preserving null.

Liam O'Connor: ugh, that sounds like the coercion path in the schema helper. Does it happen on all retries or just first try?

Maya Chen: Only saw it when the request retried once (auth retry). Locally repro'd by forcing a 401 then retry. When no retry, items stays null.

Devex Bot: CI job #482 failed: unit tests/sampleapp/schema-validation — mismatch for order.update arguments (expected null, got array) :warning:

Samir Patel: My guess: the helper tries to normalize arrays for downstream tooling and interprets nullable+missing as [] during the second serialize pass. SDK parity note: JS helper has a "preserveNulls" option in a private branch; Python doesn't.

Maya Chen: Any quick workaround? We ship next week.

Samir Patel: Quick hack you can try in app code: post-process the fncall args before passing to the helper: if schema says nullable and value === undefined -> set to null. Ugly but fast. Example: 
```js
function fixNullables(args, schema) {
  // naive: walk keys, if schema.nullable && Array.isArray(val) && val.length === 0 && schema.allowsNull) return null;
  // apply only for known fields like items
  if (args.items && Array.isArray(args.items) && args.items.length === 0 && schema.items?.nullable) args.items = null;
  return args;
}
```

Liam O'Connor: Can you paste the exact SDK call you used? Might be useful for a unit test.

Maya Chen: Sure — simplified: 
```js
await redwood.sdk.callFunction({
  name: 'order.update',
  arguments: { items: null },
  jsonMode: true,
});
```
Then network glitches -> auth retry -> helper reserializes arguments and ends up with [].

Nora Lee: Filed a shortnote in the onboarding docs about this class of gotcha? New interns keep hitting it.

Maya Chen: Not yet, I'll add a short line to the starter-kit README.

Samir Patel: I'll open a PR to (1) add preserveNullArrays flag to the public JS SDK, (2) add a unit test that simulates a retry and asserts null stays null, and (3) add a TODO for Python parity.

Samir Patel: Work items: 
- PR (JS) with flag + tests
- Doc note in starter-kit README (Maya)
- Issue for Python SDK parity (I'll file)

Nora Lee: Adding the CI failure to the release board.

Maya Chen: Thanks! If anyone wants the minimal repro script I used I can drop it here. :wave:

Liam O'Connor: Please do, will help nail the flaky test. :thumbsup:

Devex Bot: Issue created: DEVEX-1127 "fncall helper: nested nullable arrays coerced to [] on retry" assigned to Samir Patel :bug:
